golden_baseline_location: Output of the legacy Perl report run through scripts/tp-run-deterministic.sh over the same inputs. This is the only consumer of the estate we can actually see, so its numbers are the business-recognisable acceptance test.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (T1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.
Gold carries no unmasked CUSTOMER_MASTER PII, and no export copies cleartext PII out (STOPA-PII). A PR that does either is rejected regardless of its recon result.

Every total, subtotal and grouping in the legacy report reproduces to the cent, including totals the legacy report computes inconsistently — differences are reported as listed, deliberate divergences, never silently corrected.

The recon report restates the D4-1 coverage gap: the consumer population is declared unmapped and no audit observation window was run (D4-2), so 'the finance report is the only consumer' is an artifact-derived claim, not evidence.

planted_anomalies.description: Report totals accumulated in Perl floating point rather than decimal.
Readers of OW_BILLING outside the visible batch chain and this report.
planted_anomalies.reason: The consumer population is declared UNMAPPED at intake (D4-1) and the customer declined an audit observation window (D4-2), so no evidence about real readers exists or will be collected. Declared as a coverage gap here rather than implied by the report's coverage.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: A month with no invoices produces a report with explicit zeros, matching the legacy report's shape, rather than an absent report a consumer would read as 'not run yet'.
